entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
In order to give inclination to the Quraysh.
(Allah gave them) the inclination during both of their (business) journeys in the winter and the summer.
So, they should worship the Lord of this House (i.e. of the Ka'bah).
The One Who gave them food in hunger and secured them from great fear.
